analysis.tier_note: the reading and the probes disagree
analysis.reasoning: The RTL explicitly gates ship-out advancement on drain_stage_ready, which depends on out_ready, so deasserted out_ready backpressures writeout. The comment also states the stage register adds one cycle of drain fill latency. Thus the implementation is not literally stall-free at the output interface, supporting the finding.
analysis.would_confirm: Simulate or formally check the ship-out FSM with out_ready deasserted to see whether writeout stalls and incurs fill latency.
